title: Ultrahigh surface area polypyrrole-based carbons with superior performance for hydrogen storage
material_description: CP-4-600 | polypyrrole-derived N-containing activated carbon: polypyrrole (FeCl3 oxidative polymerization of pyrrole) activated with KOH at KOH/PPy weight ratio 4 at 600 °C for 1 h under N2
purification_method: washed with 10 wt% HCl, then distilled water to neutral pH; dried at 120 °C
activation_method: KOH activation of polypyrrole, KOH/PPy weight ratio 4, heated at 3 °C/min under N2 to 600 °C, held 1 h
source_location: main-4, Table 1, row CP-4-600, column H2 uptake [wt %], value in parentheses (1 bar, footnote g); same point as main-4 Fig. 3a, series CP-4-600 (open circles)
notes: digitized: 0.990 bar, 1.951 wt%, archive: HYC-0094_fig3a_CP-4-600.json. Vmicro = 72% of total pore volume (Table 1). PSD maxima (NLDFT, slit pores): 1.3/2.2 nm; first maximum stored. T printed as -196 °C (77.15 K). BET range: 0.04 to 0.2. Surface area and pore data from N2 sorption at -196 °C (Micromeritics ASAP 2020); total pore volume from N2 adsorbed at P/Po ~ 0.99; micropore area and volume by t-plot. Helium (skeletal) density by gas pycnometry (AccuPyc, Micromeritics); packing density after pressing the sample in a mould at 7 MPa (compacted). Buoyancy correction used densities of 0.04 g cm-3 (adsorbed H2) and 1.72-2.31 g cm-3 (carbons). N content method not stated in main text (ESI not provided). Degassing and H2 sample mass not stated.

purification_method: washed with 10 wt% HCl, then distilled water to neutral pH; dried at 120 °C
activation_method: KOH activation of polypyrrole, KOH/PPy weight ratio 4, heated at 3 °C/min under N2 to 600 °C, held 1 h
source_location: main-4, Fig. 3a, series CP-4-600 (open circles), marker at 7.99 bar
notes: archive: HYC-0094_fig3a_CP-4-600.json. Marker centre located on the page image (template matching) and rendered for digitize_figure.py (see log.md). Vmicro = 72% of total pore volume (Table 1). PSD maxima (NLDFT, slit pores): 1.3/2.2 nm; first maximum stored. T printed as -196 °C (77.15 K). BET range: 0.04 to 0.2. Surface area and pore data from N2 sorption at -196 °C (Micromeritics ASAP 2020); total pore volume from N2 adsorbed at P/Po ~ 0.99; micropore area and volume by t-plot. Helium (skeletal) density by gas pycnometry (AccuPyc, Micromeritics); packing density after pressing the sample in a mould at 7 MPa (compacted). Buoyancy correction used densities of 0.04 g cm-3 (adsorbed H2) and 1.72-2.31 g cm-3 (carbons). N content method not stated in main text (ESI not provided). Degassing and H2 sample mass not stated.
basis_evidence: "Figure 3a shows the total hydrogen uptake isotherms for the various activated carbons." (total not defined; gravimetric IGA data "corrected for the buoyancy of the system and samples")
